title: Innovation in Product Management
content:
Creating products that consistently drive innovation is a challenge. This talk, developed in collaboration with Product People, focuses on practical actions that product managers can take to drive meaningful innovation — while maintaining momentum and addressing critical strategic questions.

The core challenge: how do you balance discovery with strategic focus, especially within larger organisations where the pressure to deliver near-term results often crowds out the space needed to experiment and explore?

Key themes

  • How to create the organisational conditions that make innovation possible
  • Practical steps for maintaining discovery momentum inside delivery-heavy teams
  • Why strategic focus and innovation are not in conflict — and how to hold both simultaneously

About the talk

This talk was delivered in collaboration with Product People and is available to view via the LinkedIn events link.

Speaker: Remko Vermeulen, VP & Head of Product
